source_refs.finding: A loaded for all MR; each B fragment reused over all MR. Publication hooks restricted to fragment==0; bounded ring copy is source-visible.
PublishM chooses A prefetch point before final M repeat.
A_RING=min(E_M,3); PUBLISH_M stored in traits but no current-body reference.
GroupN used only for grid_n>=256 and M>BM; narrow-N fixed GroupM4 branch; explicit GroupM override.
A ring slots, B per-N fragment reuse, K+2 release at E_M-A_RING. Deferred wait only FixedK16384 arrays E_M4/E_N8.
Existing geometry, publication, m-repeat/cache/fragment/GroupN configs are stable appended IDs.
TopN selects complete geometries per pipeline; seed adds only exact kid.
A/B int32 byte limit, bounded per-tile C span, JIT wide total C allowance.
C tile base uses int64 row*stride; SRD span bounded to valid rows.

cases.note: NB differs across several equal B_AHEAD rows, so retain different A stage schedules.

At NB3, BD1/BD2 have equal effective queue and all other traits equal. Six duplicate entries per plain geometry (3 cache pairs x 2 outputs); 48→42 effective schedules. This is schedule-semantic equivalence, not a promise of identical symbol/code-layout latency.
Current48094 has B_AHEAD8/B_SETS9/72 B dwords per lane.
NR4, BK128, FixedK>=1536 clamp to3. CO379 ba2 and CO688 bd1 both effective3, but differ in XCD/contiguous and must not be deduplicated as a complete experiment.

effective_parameter_dedup.GroupN_condition: With all other parameters unchanged, GroupN has no tile-mapping effect when grid_n<256 or M<=BM; a positive explicit GroupM also overwrites the GroupN branch mapping.
effective_parameter_dedup.narrow_N_bound: N<=2048 and legal BN in64/128/256 implies grid_n<=32<256. GroupN4/8/16/32/64 does not affect the executed tile mapping. Compiler symbol/code placement can still differ.

future_source_changes.change: Append an opt-in PublishFragment=0 trait/name field to B-VGPR overlap. Current hook only fragment==0; add one experiment PublishFragment=1 with unchanged PublishM, geometry, queue, pinning and output. Keep every existing ID/default unchanged.
future_source_changes.hypothesis: Shift A publication relative to B fragment requests; source proves a missing schedule degree of freedom, not a measured bottleneck.
required_dependency_work: Recompute issue-event counts used by wa/newer_b/pending_a waits, not just the issue_a condition.
Statically simulate prologue/steady/tail pending VMEM and A LDS slot ownership for all phases.
Preserve B consumption before slot reuse and every fragment reuse over MR.
Only after existing-config results, validate correctness and saved winner protection before performance interpretation.

future_source_changes.change: Append an opt-in AFragmentRing parameter with default current min(E_M,3); initially compare ring2 versus ring3 for 256x256x128 WM4 E_M4/E_N8. Derive release event from E_M-A_RING rather than moving publication to unused PUBLISH_M=0.
future_source_changes.hypothesis: Ring2 reduces declared A fragments 24→16 dwords/lane and moves safe K+2 publication m1→m2; remaining current MFMAs24→16. The lost overlap can outweigh the smaller A live set.
required_dependency_work: Keep B resident E_N fragments once per K tile and reuse each over every M repeat.
Require 1<=A_RING<=E_M and maintain m+A_RING load/overwrite-after-last-consumer invariant.
Retain full workgroup barrier before overwriting current LDS stage.
Do not extend FixedK16384 defer-next-stage-wait to K7168 without a separately proven VMEM event count.
Treat existing traits PublishM as inactive in the current m-repeat body; changing it alone has no current source-defined publication effect.

decision_order: Measure only these existing exact entries with the four current anchors and fixed saved CSV comparisons.
Interpret missing coverage separately from controlled rechecks; do not label every unmeasured legal entry a bottleneck.
Promote a source proposal only if existing-parameter comparisons support its mechanism; source changes remain outside first round.
Keep winner protection and >4GiB CPU address guard outside the sixteen initial pairs.

measurement_evidence_limits: Current best exact names/IDs/us are retained; reconstructed Top8 proves selection membership, not individual candidate latency or correctness.
Three retained all-candidate artifacts scanned contained no exact proposed pair result.
